form_name: Connecticut DMV Form A-83 (Special Power of Attorney)

fields.label: (Print your full name above)
fields.notes: Blank in the sentence 'that I, ___, do hereby appoint'.

fields.label: (Print full name of your agent above)
fields.notes: Blank in the sentence '..., do hereby appoint ___, as my attorney-in-fact'.

fields.label: day of
fields.notes: First of three blanks in 'I have hereunto signed my name below on this ___ day of ___, 20___.'

fields.label: day of [month blank]
fields.notes: Second of three blanks (month name) in the execution-date sentence.
Third blank (last two digits of year) in the execution-date sentence.

fields.label: Principal: (Sign your full name as above)
(Signature of Witness)
fields.notes: Second, identically-labeled witness signature line; form requires two witnesses.

fields.label: Personally appeared , signer and sealer of the foregoing Power of Attorney
fields.notes: Blank filled in by the notary/officer with the principal's full name.

fields.label: before me, this ___ day of
fields.notes: First of three blanks in the acknowledgment date sentence.

fields.label: day of ___, 20___
fields.notes: Second blank (month name) in the acknowledgment date sentence.
Third blank (last two digits of year) in the acknowledgment date sentence.

fields.label: Notary Public/Justice of Peace Commissioner of the Superior Court
fields.notes: Unlabeled signature line above the printed 'Notary Public/Justice of Peace / Commissioner of the Superior Court' caption.

fields.label: My commission expires:
fields.notes: Applicable only when the signing officer is a Notary Public (not a Justice of the Peace or Commissioner of the Superior Court).
